reason: The done/push/shrink/drop prompt is exactly the moment my plan dies at 11am, so I'd try the free plan, but nothing here says it syncs two ways with my work Google/Outlook calendar or has keyboard shortcuts and integrations. On $29k I'm not paying $12 a month for a tool I'd be double-entering meetings into.
objection: If it can't read and write my work calendar both ways, every block I drag in is a lie by noon and I'm back to maintaining two calendars. I've been burned by that with these apps before.
would_change_my_mind: Proof of real two-way sync with both Google and Outlook work calendars, plus a full keyboard-driven flow, shown during the no-card trial.
